title: History / s
description: Seconds of play kept behind the now line during gameplay (5–60). With the map's density lane, a further fifth of that previews the density ahead of it.

title: Map density lane
description: Draw the map's difficulty strain (vosu performance graph) behind your trace and ahead of the now line. Off, or when the host sends no strain (the replay renderer, tosu), the strip ends at the now line.

title: Orientation
description: auto = follow the page's box: vertical when taller than wide (time runs upward like the mania editor), horizontal when wider (time runs left to right).

title: Alignment
description: The side of the stage the page sits on. left = the page sits left of the stage: the zero line and the readouts face right, toward the stage, and KPS grows away from it. right = the mirror image. Horizontal boxes put the readouts on that side.

title: Show in song select and results
description: Song select: the map's strain density over its whole length and its average notes per second, plus your last run on it. Results: the whole run's KPS curve with peak, average and key count. osu! shows none of these, but the page keeps its gameplay position, which on those screens usually covers osu!'s own panels — enable it when your source sits somewhere free on them.

title: Motion
description: full = values ease, events flash, kiai sections breathe. Here: a broken peak record flashes, the density lane brightens through kiai. reduced = values and enter/exit still ease; no pulses, flashes or kiai ambience. off = everything instant.

title: Backing
description: scrim = a dark field with soft edges that keeps small text readable on bright maps. panel = a solid graphite panel. none = text straight on the game with a contrast shadow; only for a dimmed background.

title: Map colour
description: Colour the map's identity (the density lane) from the map's background. Off = neutral. Your own trace head and peak stay 18-LAB amber either way.
